verdict.rationale: The evidence describes PlayCanvas exposing an official MCP server so external AI assistants/agents can control the Editor (playcanvas-docs-6, playcanvas-docs-34, playcanvas-probe-3) — i.e., PlayCanvas is the MCP server being plugged into, not a client consuming external MCP servers' tools. As a 3D engine/editor platform rather than an AI agent or orchestration layer, PlayCanvas has no role as an MCP client ingesting third-party tool servers, so this client-side axis is a category mismatch for this product.
